column2: The life of [Root.GetBestName] is over. Will you continue the tale of the [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty as [player_heir.GetBestName], or is there perhaps someone else you would rather play as...?
I will play as [player_heir.GetBestName]!
I will play as another descendant of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as a spouse of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]
I will play as a sibling of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as a friend of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as a lover of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as a rival of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as someone of a different culture!
I will play as someone of a different religion!
I will play as a distant relative of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
I will play as someone with a different government type!
I will play as another member of [Root.Society.GetName]!
You will keep playing as [player_heir.GetBestName], as expected.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_child_grandchild.GetBestName] instead. [player_heir_option_child_grandchild.GetSheHeCap] is still a descendant of [Root.GetFirstName], after all...
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_spouse.GetBestName] instead. [player_heir_option_spouse.GetSheHeCap] was maybe the true power in [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] all along...
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_sibling.GetBestName] instead. Perhaps you always should have played as [player_heir_option_sibling.GetHerHim]...
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_friend.GetBestName] instead, helping [player_heir_option_friend.GetHerHim] cope with the loss of [player_heir_option_friend.GetHerHis] friend.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_lover.GetBestName] instead, helping [player_heir_option_lover.GetHerHim] cope with the loss of [player_heir_option_lover.GetHerHis] lover.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_rival.GetBestName] instead, no doubt celebrating the death of [Root.GetFirstName].
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_culture.GetBestName] instead, giving you the opportunity to experience the [player_heir_option_culture.Culture.GetName] culture.

You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_religion.GetBestName] instead, giving you the opportunity to worship [player_heir_option_religion.Religion.GetHighGodName] as a [player_heir_option_religion.Religion.GetName] faithful.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_distant.GetBestName] instead. A fairly distant relation, but still family.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_government.GetBestName] instead, which will mean playing as a [player_heir_option_government.Government.GetName] ruler.
You will keep playing as [player_heir_option_society.GetBestName] instead. There is still much to do on behalf of [Root.Society.GetName]...
